verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a framework for building voice agents. A framework's ecosystem could plausibly ship a built-in assistant in its CLI or cloud dashboard, so the axis applies. The pack shows no first-party assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The context-hub MCP server and the generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files only serve the user's own external coding agent. The voice bots users build are the framework's output, not an assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
